quest.title: Verses and Vistas of Lantern Rite (Part I)
quest.description: The artist Vermeer is puzzling over how to capture the Lantern Rite in a painting...
quest.rewards_formatted: Primogem x30, Mora x20000, Festive Fever x100

dialogues.speaker: Vermeer
dialogues.text: No this isn't right, and that's not right either...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What's the matter?

dialogues.speaker: Vermeer
dialogues.text: Oh, hello. I'm just here collecting some materials.

dialogues.speaker: Vermeer
dialogues.text: Given that the Lantern Rite festival is already in full swing, I was thinking about how I could create a painting that depicts Liyue Harbor during the festival.

dialogues.speaker: Vermeer
dialogues.text: *sigh* Maybe it's a problem with my technique or something, but no matter what I do, the painting just doesn't feel right.

dialogues.speaker: Vermeer
dialogues.text: Maybe a change of scenery would give me more inspiration, but I can't seem to find anywhere better...

dialogues.speaker: Vermeer
dialogues.text: Traveler, do you know of any scenic spots that would be suitable for painting?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: We'll have a look around!

dialogues.speaker: Vermeer
dialogues.text: Oh, good. Let's have a look together then. Maybe we'll be able to find a nice scenic spot.

dialogues.speaker: Vermeer
dialogues.text: Now here's a good view of the landscape... Oh, who's this?

dialogues.speaker: Qingzhou
dialogues.text: My name is Qingzhou, my liege. I might add that I consider myself a poet, if I may be so bold. And you are...

dialogues.speaker: Vermeer
dialogues.text: Ah, so you're a poet? Haha. Well, I'm a painter and I'm looking for some scenic spots nearby to help give me some inspiration.

dialogues.speaker: Qingzhou
dialogues.text: Inspiration, you say? Why, this is quite a coincidence. I myself am also seeking a stroke of inspiration. May I be so bold as to ask the purpose for which you seek to be inspired?

dialogues.speaker: Vermeer
dialogues.text: Certainly. I intend to paint a scene of Liyue Harbor during the Lantern Rite. This traveler here was assisting me in my search for a suitable landscape.

dialogues.speaker: Vermeer
dialogues.text: And may I ask what you are seeking inspiration for?

dialogues.speaker: Qingzhou
dialogues.text: Yes, quite the coincidence indeed. I also intend to write a poem about Liyue Harbor during the Lantern Rite. I'm seeking inspiration, just as you are.

dialogues.speaker: Vermeer
dialogues.text: I see...

dialogues.speaker: Qingzhou
dialogues.text: Hmm...

dialogues.speaker: Vermeer
dialogues.text: Wouldn't a poem be a little too simple? How could an amazing festival like the Lantern Rite and Liyue Harbor itself possibly fit into a few lines of poetry?

dialogues.speaker: Vermeer
dialogues.text: Hah, if you ask me, only a great painting could properly capture the essence of the festival.

dialogues.speaker: Qingzhou
dialogues.text: A great painting, you say? Hehe, I fear that such a work would only be a waste of good brush and ink. A painting could never truly capture the subtle charm of the Lantern Rite and would fail to accurately render the spirit of Liyue.

dialogues.speaker: Qingzhou
dialogues.text: Furthermore, could the grandeur of a land as magnificent as Liyue ever possibly be captured in a painting?

dialogues.speaker: Vermeer
dialogues.text: Haha, I think a painting would be better.

dialogues.speaker: Qingzhou
dialogues.text: Hehe, and I think a poem would be better suited.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Whoa, calm down you two.

dialogues.speaker: Vermeer
dialogues.text: Arguing like this won't solve anything. I propose we each create a work depicting Liyue Harbor during the Lantern Rite...

dialogues.speaker: Vermeer
dialogues.text: Once we've both finished our works, we can put them on display and invite someone to judge them. What do you say?

dialogues.speaker: Qingzhou
dialogues.text: Your proposition is acceptable. I shall await your presence at Wangshu Inn once you have completed your... painting. Then we shall entreat an impartial judge to critique our work.

dialogues.speaker: Vermeer
dialogues.text: Good, you have a deal.

dialogues.speaker: Qingzhou
dialogues.text: It's settled then. If you would excuse me, I shall take my leave now.

dialogues.speaker: Vermeer
dialogues.text: He sure does talk big for a poet. And to think he actually believes that the Lantern Rite and Liyue Harbor can be expressed with a few lines of poetry, hah!

dialogues.speaker: Vermeer
dialogues.text: I'll show him! He won't even stand a chance once I finish my painting.

dialogues.speaker: Vermeer
dialogues.text: I'll need to pour all my creativity into this one. In fact, I should even specially prepare some paints and brushes for this particular piece.

dialogues.speaker: Vermeer
dialogues.text: Traveler, could I trouble you to help me collect some special materials?

response.speaker: Vermeer
response.text: Good, I'm counting on you. Now let me think...

response.speaker: Vermeer
response.text: Oh, I'll need you to collect Whopperflower Nectar from a Pyro Whopperflower.

response.speaker: Vermeer
response.text: With that, I'll be able to make mix some special paint.

choices.text: What kind of materials do you need?

dialogues.speaker: Vermeer
dialogues.text: So, were you able to get the Whopperflower Nectar I need?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Here it is.

dialogues.speaker: Vermeer
dialogues.text: Let me see here. Oh, here we go... Yes, this will do just fine.

dialogues.speaker: Vermeer
dialogues.text: Once the paint is ready, all we'll need to do is find a suitable landscape and then I can start painting.

dialogues.speaker: Vermeer
dialogues.text: Humph, just wait until that poet sees my painting...

dialogues.speaker: Vermeer
dialogues.text: Ah, I've just remembered! It's a tradition to release Xiao Lanterns during Liyue's Lantern Rite. People even write wishes on the lanterns, right?

dialogues.speaker: Vermeer
dialogues.text: Hehehe, I've even prepared a Xiao Lantern here, and as for the wish... Well, I won't tell you, otherwise it might not come true.

dialogues.speaker: Vermeer
dialogues.text: Oh, I nearly forgot, these are for you. I guess you could consider them your reward. Thanks for the help!

dialogues.speaker: Vermeer
dialogues.text: I can't wait to see the look on that poet's face when he sees my painting.

dialogues.speaker: Vermeer
dialogues.text: Hmph, my painting will leave that poet in tears of amazement.
